gaps.term: Transform needs address rearrangement at each level
gaps.quote: The transform calculation needs them because it works by rearranging addresses, and rearranging is not free.
gaps.note: The page asserts that the transform works by rearranging addresses and that each transform level may need a rearrangement, but never says which rearrangement a level performs or why it is needed. The reader has not studied tape-level data-movement algorithms, so this cannot be checked from the page.

The page infers that the array holds Theta(n) bits from n being the input size, but never says what the array contains or how its size relates to the input (padding or expansion). The reader cannot check this step from the page.
